new_alerts.thesis: NeOnc's binary NEO100 catalyst read out positive on Aug 12, 2026, hitting the primary PFS-6 endpoint at 48.9% versus a 20% historical benchmark with high statistical significance (p=0.0047), plus favorable overall-survival data and a clean safety profile. The stock spiked as much as 45%+ on the news and continued running to a post-catalyst high near $13 before retracing to consolidate in the $4.60-5.10 range through late August into September — a normal, healthy digestion of a genuine positive surprise rather than a failed or ambiguous readout. Layered on top of this confirmed catalyst is the standout signal for this entire group: uninterrupted open-market cash buying by both co-CEOs (Heshmatpour and Chen) with zero insider sales for six straight months, continuing right through and after the readout, alongside a small but genuinely net-positive institutional buying trend (13 buyers vs. 2 sellers, $14M+ net inflows). The combination of a de-risked, positive binary catalyst plus continuing insider conviction buying at post-catalyst prices materially strengthens the thesis and justifies an upgrade to HIGH-CONVICTION WATCH.
new_alerts.risks: Extremely small-cap/micro-cap (~$128M market cap) with thin absolute liquidity and wide potential swings; Phase 2a was open-label, single-arm, underpowered (24 of a planned 28 patients), not confirmatory, and lacked a randomized control arm per the company's own stated limitations; FDA Type B meeting outcome and ultimate registrational pathway design remain uncertain; stock is down significantly from its post-catalyst peak near $13, and continued insider buying, while a positive signal, cannot fully de-risk clinical/regulatory execution ahead.
